title: Wont buy dried lavender again!
text: Wont buy dried lavender again!. Very disappointed. Most of the lavender had fallen off of the stems and was in the bottom of the plastic bag that the bunch was in. When I opened the package, a lovely lavender scent came out, but it didn’t last long at all.  Maybe if the packaging was better all of the beautiful buds wouldn’t have fallen off. I may be returning.
